nodes.description: ChowChow private mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many sell/transfer actions each address has performed
ChowChow private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist that bypasses sale-limit restrictions
ChowChow private minimum transfer amount allowed by the sale restriction
ChowChow private maximum transfer amount allowed by the sale restriction
ChowChow private maximum number of transfers an address may perform
ChowChow privileged address that bypasses all transfer restrictions
ChowChow public mapping(address=>uint) token balances, written without SafeMath
ChowChow public nested mapping of spending allowances, decremented without SafeMath
ChowChow constant decimals = 18 used in supply and mint scaling
ChowChow public total token supply set in the constructor
ChowChow private owner address granting admin privileges and transfer exemptions
ChowChow public token name
ChowChow public token symbol
msg.sender, the external caller controlling approvals, allowances, ownership checks and constructor ownership
ChowChow.transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable; delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender
ChowChow.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) payable; validates via ensure and mutates allowance/balanceOf with raw arithmetic
ChowChow.ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; grants bypass to owner, tradeAddress and canSale entries
ChowChow.approve(address _spender, uint _value) payable; writes the caller's allowance
ChowChow.condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale restrictions
ChowChow.approveAndCall(address spender, uint256 addedValue); owner-only mint plus whitelist of an arbitrary address
ChowChow.transferownership(address addr); owner-only assignment of the privileged tradeAddress
ChowChow constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; sets metadata, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender and mints all tokens to the deployer
SafeBEP20.callOptionalReturn(IBEP20 token, bytes data) private; performs a raw low-level call to an external token contract
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath)
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath)
Unchecked multiplication addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) used as a mint amount in approveAndCall
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate inside approveAndCall
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate inside transferownership
Low-level address(token).call(data) external interaction inside callOptionalReturn; state changes are not finalized before the call in transfer flows

edges.reason: transfer delegates the whole transfer to transferFrom
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument
transferFrom invokes ensure to validate the transfer
ensure calls condition when no bypass applies
ensure reads owner to bypass all restrictions
ensure reads tradeAddress to bypass all restrictions
ensure reads canSale whitelist to bypass restrictions
condition reads the _saleNum transfer-count limit
condition reads the _minSale minimum transfer limit
condition reads the _maxSale maximum transfer limit
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address cap
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom subtracts from and adds to balanceOf
msg.sender determines whose allowance may be spent in transferFrom
approve writes allowance for the calling msg.sender
the owner check in approveAndCall is decided by msg.sender
the owner check in transferownership is decided by msg.sender
constructor stores msg.sender as owner and mints the supply to it
approveAndCall is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
transferownership is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner)
approveAndCall enables canSale[spender], bypassing the sale restrictions for an arbitrary address
approveAndCall writes balanceOf[spender] with an unchecked amount
the minted amount is computed by unchecked multiplication addedValue*10**decimals
transferFrom subtracts allowance without SafeMath protection
transferFrom updates balances with raw +=/-= arithmetic
transferownership overwrites the privileged tradeAddress
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply
constructor sets the token name
constructor sets the token symbol
callOptionalReturn hands execution to an external token contract through a low-level call
the arbitrary token address parameter is the target of the low-level call
attacker-influenced calldata is forwarded to the external token contract
_to defines the recipient forwarded by transfer
_value defines the amount forwarded by transfer
_from decides whose allowance and balance are debited
_to is the credited account in transferFrom
_value drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic
_from is tested against owner, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure
_to is tested against owner in ensure
_value is passed from ensure into condition
_spender receives the caller-controlled allowance
_value is stored verbatim in the allowance mapping
spender is whitelisted in canSale and funded by approveAndCall
addedValue feeds the unchecked mint multiplication
addr becomes the new privileged tradeAddress
